paragraphs: Following the release of the seventh developer betas for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, and Apple’s other upcoming software updates, the company is now rolling out the corresponding public betas. Here are the details.

Now, Apple is rolling out their equivalents to the public beta, marking the fifth public beta rollout. So far, Apple has released new public betas for iOS 27, tvOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, and HomePod 27.
Today’s releases do not include any particularly notable changes, as Apple is now focused primarily on bug fixes and stability improvements ahead of the official release expected in a few weeks.

Additionally, Apple also rolled out the second public RC for macOS Sequoia 15.8 (24H20), following the release of the corresponding developer RC earlier today. The second RC for macOS Tahoe 26.7 (25G224) is expected to drop soon. also available as of 7:42 p.m. ET.
Across all of today’s releases, the public beta builds carry the same build numbers as their developer counterparts.

Apple recommends installing beta software on a secondary device. If you use your primary iPhone, make sure you have a recent backup first.
